# Prompt Sidequest

> Prompt Sidequest helps everyday people use AI for more than search: copy-paste prompts, no-code app/website build guides, no-code AI agent setups, and AI for gamers. Free newsletter plus paid digital packs.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://promptsidequest.com/): overview, sample prompts, products
- [10 free AI prompts](https://promptsidequest.com/prompts/): copy-paste prompts for life, work, learning, building and gaming
- [AI agents for beginners](https://promptsidequest.com/agents/): what AI agents are and how to set one up without code
- [Free PDF: 50 Prompts for Real Life](https://promptsidequest.com/free/50-prompts.pdf): 16-page free prompt pack, six quests
- [Newsletter](https://promptsidequest.beehiiv.com/subscribe): free, hosted on beehiiv

## Products
- [Agent Template Pack](https://promptsidequest.gumroad.com/l/xiors): $29 USD. 31-page PDF + plain-text prompts. 12 copy-paste, no-code AI agents (inbox triage, daily briefing, meal planner, budget watcher, job scout, gaming patch-notes tracker and more), each with setup steps, safety rules and an illustrative example run. Sold via Gumroad.
- Coming soon (not yet available): The Prompt Library, Build Without Code, Gamer's Guild Pack.
